headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment Certification on Listed Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited has certified timely payment of interest on its listed Secured and Unsecured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures, in compliance with SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulation 57.
implication: Routine debenture interest certification demonstrates ongoing regulatory compliance for listed debt instruments; material for bondholders' credit monitoring and signals no covenant breach or payment distress.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited filed a regulatory update with NSE confirming that it has made timely interest payments on both Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (SRNCDs) and Unsecured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures (URNCDs) that were issued via public issue and listed on stock exchanges. The certification was made pursuant to SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015, Regulation 57, which mandates periodic disclosure of material events including debt servicing. This filing is a routine but material disclosure for debt capital market participants and confirms the issuer's financial stability on its fixed-income obligations.
